nodes.name: Approval request
nodes.notes: The MCP gateway posts every write that needs a human here (create_case). Requests without the shared X-Ridgeline-Approval header are refused.

nodes.name: Acknowledge with the form link
nodes.notes: Answers the gateway at once with the signed link to this request's approval form.

nodes.name: Human decision
nodes.notes: Waits until a person opens the form and chooses Approve or Reject. The form closes when the gateway stops waiting (expires_in_s), so a late visitor sees an expired link.

parameters.formDescription: ={{ 'Request ' + $('Approval request').item.json.body.request_id + ': agent ' + $('Approval request').item.json.body.client_id + ' asks to run ' + $('Approval request').item.json.body.tool + ' for ' + $('Approval request').item.json.body.account_id + ' (' + $('Approval request').item.json.body.account_name + '). Subject: ' + $('Approval request').item.json.body.subject + '. Summary: ' + $('Approval request').item.json.body.summary }}

values.formSubmittedText: Decision sent to the gateway. If the request had already expired or the gateway restarted, nothing was written; the agent's terminal and `make audit` show the outcome.

nodes.name: Tell the gateway
nodes.notes: Reports the decision with the one-time token of this request. The gateway address is fixed here, never taken from the request. A request the gateway no longer waits for gets 404, which ends this run quietly; nothing is written for it.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ request_id: $('Approval request').item.json.body.request_id, token: $('Approval request').item.json.body.callback_token, decision: $json.Decision, approver: $json.Approver }) }}
